title: Staircase Deepener (F4A (Deepener))
description: As the title suggests, this is a short visualisation exercise, and hypnotic sequence, in which I guide your mind's eye down a dark winding flight of stairs. One that stretches down into the very depths of your subconscious mind, and lets me take you even deeper under my control. With each of the ten steps I'll guide your thoughts and actions; as you nod and breath, and relax into a profoundly mindless peace. Don't worry pet... You're safe here in the darkness with me when you breath in my words. Simply inhaling tranquility, and exhaling any conscious thoughts. Just melting into a warm puddle, dripping and pulled along, as we go ever downwards. Letting me take you into the bubble that is my own private hypnotic world. And on the way, when your reality is at its most dim and distant, I'll gift you my own little trigger to help you finally give in...
author: Mistress Shibby
